item.title: Commands
item.description:
termorq-cli is a Pro-only companion tool. Its commands are listed here for Pro builds; the CLI has no edition switch. See the Free and Pro feature breakdown for app features.

@ opens the command list in the prompt block. Type to filter command names. The matching letters are underlined. Cmd+Shift+F (Ctrl+Shift+F on Windows and Linux) matches letters in order anywhere in the name. Press it again to match the typed text as a block. Entries from commands.yaml follow these built-ins. @history is always available and is not a line in that file.

item.title: Keyboard
item.description:
Cmd+/ on macOS, or Ctrl+/ on Windows and Linux, opens the shortcuts dialog. The search box at the top has focus, so you can type straight away to filter the keys, @ triggers, and call flags; matches are highlighted. Esc clears the search, then closes the dialog. Press the shortcut again to close it.

Cmd+, on macOS, or Ctrl+, on Windows and Linux, opens Settings with the cursor in its search box. Press it again to go back to the terminal. The footer hint (⌘/ help or Ctrl+/ help) opens the same dialog.

item.title: Files
item.description:
Two places hold state. The data folder is this machine. The workspace folder is what you commit.

Data folder link

termorq under the platform data directory.

Builds before this change used com.garrardkitchen.ai-terminal. When the app or termorq-cli starts and finds that folder, it moves the contents into termorq. If a file exists in both, the copy in termorq is kept. The old folder is then deleted. If any copy fails, the old folder is kept and the move runs again at the next start.
